lines.text: Show off something you're proud of.
He keeps flexing his new sneakers online.

data.mean: Show off something you're proud of.
data.define: To show off what you have or can do.

example.text: He keeps flexing his new sneakers online.

misuse.text: Don't 'flex' your salary at a job interview.
